intended_behavior.objective: Introduce a single residue identity/order/adjacency contract that preserves authoritative source order (source_order / label_seq_id) instead of re-ordering by alphabetical insertion code.
scope: processor.py: Atom gains source_order; assigned monotonic per-residue from file order.
tier1_measurements._extract: order residues by source-order key.
out_of_scope: No coordinate-hash / OD-07 changes (identity sorting unchanged).
No ingestion parser replacement (Gemmi path retained).

security_and_correctness_risks: Changing residue order could alter per-law observations; confined to structures whose source order differs from (seq, icode) sort.
Fallback ordering for atoms lacking source_order is deterministic (seq/icode).
Real 1PPE/5T4O fixtures are not present; synthetic reproductions are used; real fixtures should be added on top.
test_plan: backend/tests/test_residue_order.py (insertion source-order reproduction, old-vs-new gap comparison, genuine gap, missing backbone, multi-chain).
Targeted law/invariance/parity tests (test_invariance, test_engine_correctness_gaps, law-120/125/135/160, coord_math).
acceptance_criteria: Full suite shows no new regressions beyond the 10 pre-existing baseline failures.
Coordinate hash / audit identity unchanged for identical inputs.
rollback_strategy: Isolated to fix/residue-order-contract; do not merge; revert forward via reviewed follow-up. No force-push.
verdict_impact: Ordering-only. No law thresholds, IDs, operators, semantics, cohorts, or hash locks change. Verdicts may change only for structures whose source order differs from alphabetical insertion-code sorting (the reproduced false-veto class).
note: OD-16 preserved: no merge/deploy/v25/held-out. This is a separate engine-correctness patch from the evaluator trust-boundary work.
